description: This file defines the ICodecProvider interface within the Orleans.Serialization.Serializers namespace. It provides abstraction for accessing codecs, activators, copiers, and related services used in serialization.

classes.name: ICodecProvider
classes.description: An interface that extends multiple provider interfaces to offer access to codecs, activators, copiers, and a service provider within the Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: Services
methods.description: A property to get the IServiceProvider instance used for dependency resolution.
